intro.text: A young Arelene woman who was married to Dilaf.

items.text: Dilaf, a Derethi gragdet from Fjorden, had been reshaped by Dakhor magic to pass as a young Arelene man so he could infiltrate Arelon. Seala met him after the change and found him very handsome, though he loathed his new body. He set aside his contempt for Aonic people, and the two married.

Ten years before the Reod, Seala came down with a severe palsy, and Dilaf reluctantly took her to Elantris for healing despite distrusting its magic. The Elantrian drew Aon Ien wrongly and it misfired, cursing her: she went bald, her skin darkened to black, and the agony never let up, much as it does for the fallen Elantrians after the Reod.

In the end the pain grew too great and she leapt from the city's walls. When Dilaf reached her she was still screaming; he burned her shattered body. He came to regret ever bringing her to the Elantrians, and wished they had simply let her die.
Her death fed Dilaf's fierce hatred of Elantrians. He believed the healer had known his origins and ruined the Aon on purpose, and he saw the invasion of Arelon as revenge for her.
